The Stowaway begins.
Heafstaag, his group of barbarians, and his allies are defeated in the Battle of Bryn Shander, thwarting their attempt to conquer the the Ten-Towns of Icewind Dale.
Using powerful wizardry and several swords of dragonblood, the adventuring band known as the Merry Marauders nearly manage to slay the green dragon Dretchroyaster.

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 140

events.text: The Red Wizards gain a concession to build a Thayan enclave in Telflamm. Serving as a distribution center for Thayan products for most of northern Faerûn, it soon grows into the largest of their enclaves.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 140

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 140

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 140

events.text: Fifty worshipers of Marthammor Duin establish a temple to their god in the crypt of Maegar beneath Berun's Hill.

Adventurers from Sundabar loot the Nameless Dungeon, taking several lost elven items. Angry at the news, local elves cause emissaries from Evermeet to place guards in the dungeon. Alustriel also sends her own troops to bolster these guardians.

events.text: Gondegal, also known as "The Usurper King" and "The Lost King", aided by a mercenary army, attempts to establish a kingdom centered in the city of Arabel in northern Cormyr. He is overthrown after only eight days in power by the standing army of Cormyr, the Purple Dragons, led by King Azoun IV. Gondegal escapes.

events.text: Agents of Lord Daigar Rosznar of Amn set fire to several Waterdhavian properties owned by the steel dragon Jalanvaloss, who in retaliation slays a pair of juvenile blue dragons employed by the Rosznars.
Secretly assisted by the Knights of the Shield, Pasha Balik takes power in Zazesspur.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 140

events.text: Wai Gada Shinzu, ruler of T'u Lung, has twin sons, Wai Anku and Wai Soreti. A variety of families, factions, and cults immediately try to take sides, giving presents to one or the other of the two sons.

Zhentil Keep betrays its allies in the Citadel of the Raven, murdering non-Zhent elements in the midst of a Zhent-sponsored orc attack. They take the Citadel and leave few survivors.

events.text: Divinations reveal Zhent treachery before the Citadel is actually taken. Melvaunt sends its army to the Citadel ostensibly to relieve the garrison from the orc attack but actually to prevent Zhentil Keep from attacking the eastern Moonsea cities. The Zhentilar outmaneuver the relief army and rush to attack the relatively undefended Melvaunt. Melvaunt manages to hire an army of mercenaries from Hillsfar and deploy them by boat against the Zhents while they are still a day's march from the city.

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 140

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 140

events.text: Lord Chancellor Rather of Melvaunt declares the Treaty of the Ride void. Zhent troops are no longer welcome on Melvauntian soil and Melvauntian ships are no longer at Zhentil Keep's disposal.
Great Fires rage across the Shining Plains within the Vilhon Reach. Followers of Talos take responsibility over these destructive acts of nature.
cites: The Vilhon Reach: Dungeon Master's Reference, с. 17

events.text: The Knights of the North are founded after the Zhentarim take hold of the Citadel of the Raven.
The Promenade of the Dark Maiden is built northeast of Skullport.
Vangerdahast sends Shaerl Rowanmantle to Shadowdale. Shaerl Rowanmantle and Mourngrym wed.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 140

events.text: The play Windbag of Waterdeep, by Tholdomor "the Wise" Rammarask, is first performed.
The book Lines I've Lived By is written by Mirt of Waterdeep.
Ashemmi reveals that she is love with Sememmon, the Lord of Darkhold, and that she is an undercover Harper agent. Sememmon's feelings are mutual and he protects her.
cites: Dragon 357: Volo's Guide: Renegades of Darkhold, с. 73

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 140

In Waterdeep, Shadowdusk Hold, the ancestral villa of House Shadowdusk is razed. The three sisters Arandraya, Maelweene, and Yarlithra are killed in the fire. It is commonly believed the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors was behind it.

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 140

events.text: This year was a "Time of the Gifted", when a select number of young Abbalayar from Ul'sahab were sent out into the rest of Faerûn to spread their prophecies and find mates, returning twenty years later.

cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: Selfaril Uoumdolphin, High Blade of Mulmaster and Tharchioness of Eltabbar Dmitra Flass begin courting one another by exchanging gifts of a perfume-scented golden earring and a cloak made from pure-white yeti fur. Having done so, they can meet in person without fear of scandal.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: Marchyan the "Mad Witch" of the Thunder Peaks was found comatose in her personal fortress by a herdsman, the halls of her domain lined with dead orcs.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: Over 1000 Statues That Walk move once again in the Old Empire of Mulhorand. They begin wandering to the nearby lands of Unther and Thay. The deity Thoth denies having any involvement with the sudden reawakening of these stone constructs.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: The village of Triboar is sacked and refugees flee north to Mirabar and Silverymoon.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 38

events.text: The adventuring company led by Mane travels in Thay for some time, and their leader is enslaved for a brief while.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 37
Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: Cyclopedia of the Realms, с. 20

events.text: A new merchant alliance, called the Iron Throne, declares their formation by sending letters to the leadership of Cormyr, Sembia and other cities such as Hillsfar. In the announcement, they state their goal of controlling all overland trade in the Eastern Heartlands.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: A roaming band of goblinoid forces, devils and dark mages ravage the Sword Coast. Baldur's Gate is under direct assault and overland traffic in northern Amn is closed altogether.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 38

events.text: A bloody battle takes place in High Horn between the Cormyrean forces and the orcs and hobgoblins of the Stonelands.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 38

events.text: Reports of a group of "monkey-faced black-haired" creatures assaulting caravans on the East Way circulate throughout Sembia.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: Thond of Wyvernwater emerges as the spokesperson for the Iron Throne and warns of sanctions against the shipment or use of any weapons in the Dalelands.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: Alassra Silverhand suddenly leaves her court in Aglarond, leaving governance of the magocratic nation to the Simbarch Council. Reports of a great magical battle over the Tower of Blades claim the Simbul was one of the combatants.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 37

events.text: As a result of the Dragonspear War, the prices of luxury items greatly increase in the city of Waterdeep.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 38

events.text: Lyran the Pretender attacks Shadowdale, and the Banite temple, the Dark Lord's Hand, is sacked.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 38

events.text: A flight of dragons over the Dalelands, Cormyr, and the Moonsea devastates these regions. Syluné of the Seven Sisters dies defending Shadowdale from a large red dragon. The Citadel of the Raven is largely destroyed.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 38

cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 38

events.text: All elvenkind are banned from the lands of Sembia, under declaration of Raithspur, Captain of the Guard of the capital of Ordulin.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 38

events.text: Lord Lashan Aumersair of Scardale conquers Harrowdale, Featherdale, and Battledale in the second inter-dale war and declares himself "King of the Dales". Lashan is soon defeated though and disappears in the ruins of Myth Drannor in Marpenoth.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 39
Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 40

events.text: Cormyr seizes Tilverton, claiming the need to protect the weakened Dalelands and the trade route of Tilver's Gap from the increasing threat of Zhentil Keep, though the move expands the Forest Kingdom's influence. Gharri the High Priest of Gond, serves as the Lord Regent of Tilverton.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: Alusair Nacacia Obarskyr, Princess of Cormyr and daughter of King Azoun IV, runs away from the royal place in Suzail. Signs of her whereabouts spring up in Tilverton, but she remains elusive from the king's forces who search for her whereabouts.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: The Company of the Hippogriff is formed by the mage of High Dale, Almontier.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: Forces from Zhentil Keep begin reconstruction efforts on the greatly damaged Citadel of the Raven.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: Following the destruction of the Moonsea, Lord Manshoon sends a decree to the leaders of Sembia, Cormyr, Scardale and Archendale stating that the combined lands north of the Moonsea are united in their protection of one another, and that any attacks against one of the cities will be met with the full power of their combined military might.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: Reconstruction of the city of Melvaunt begins, focusing first on repairing their docks and getting their fleet of ships sailing once again.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 39

events.text: The Company of the Dragon travels to the Elven Court to announce of the disappearance of nearly all the elves from the city of Hillsfar. Similar reports about the sudden vanishing of elves spring up in Sembia.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 40

events.text: Luvon Greencloak of the Elven Court formally announces the Retreat of the elves of Faerûn to the island of Evermeet in a letter to the leaders of the Dalelands, thanking them for the years of good relations since the erecting of the Standing Stone.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 40

events.text: In preparation for the annual closing of the gates of Mirabar, the council convenes at the Hall of Sparkling Stones to decide where to sell the great amount of silver they had discovered and mined that year.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 40

events.text: Barroch's Hold is discovered in the Glacier of the White Worm by a band of adventurers. Two survivors, Yostur Ulhmond and Feenoch the Five-Fingered reach the settlement of Orm to tell their tale.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 40

events.text: After unknown thieves steal the Tome of the Unicorn from the Green Library, Ruathym's forces sink a Luskanite caravel. In return, Luskan wipes out most of Ruathym's fleet, then invades the island of Ruathym. It is months before the islanders repel the invaders.
Hammer - Tarsakh: The armies of Waterdeep, Amn, and Baldur's Gate besiege Dragonspear Castle and burn it down, defeating the baatezu within in a conflict known as the Dragonspear War.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 36

events.text: The Pereghost first appears at Darkhold.
In Mithral Hall, Bruenor Battlehammer kills the shadow dragon Shimmergloom. Bruenor then drives the duergar that served the dragon, and claims his inheritance as the Eighth King of Mithral Hall.

The assassin Artemis Entreri kidnaps the halfling Regis and escapes back to Calimport. Drizzt Do'Urden and the Companions of the Hall follow their friend to Calimport and rescue Regis, in the process destroying Pasha Pook's thieves' guild. However, Regis remains in Calimport to manage the guild's operations while the Companions return to Mithral Hall.
Demons dig a tunnel out of Hellgate Keep to the Nameless Dungeon.
The Company of the White Star disbands.
The death of the Court Poet of Shou Lung leads to courtly controversy when Tan Nong, a minstrel from T'u Lung, becomes favored to repalce him.

events.text: The white dragon Icingdeath is killed by Drizzt Do'Urden and Wulfgar.
Syluné of the Seven Sisters is killed in Shadowdale battling a large red dragon.

Queen Yenandra of Dambrath, dying of old age and sickness, accepts her wizard daughter Hasifir's offer to be transformed into a spectral guardian, with the aid of a number of drow sorcerers. The transformation is a success, and Hasifir becomes queen.
Fender Mallot and Grollo, warriors of Clan Battlehammer, are killed by the assassin Artemis Entreri in Bryn Shander.
Selbryn the Sage publishes Musings From a Lonely Tower In Athkatla.

events.text: Calimshan begins building its first navy since the time of the Shoon Imperium.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 42

events.text: A Sembian ship, the Fair Venture goes missing near the Pirate Isles. Its owner, Golthond of Thesk begins exploring the idea of hiring mercenaries to clear the archipelago of their raiding corsairs.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 43

events.text: The Firemaster hires mercenaries in the cities of Suzail and Westgate, supposedly to delve into a group of ancient tombs beneath the forests north of Waymoot.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 43

events.text: Azoun IV attempts to strengthen diplomatic ties between Cormyr, Shadowdale, Mistledale, High Dale, and Deepingdale. This act worsens relations with Sembia and Archendale.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 43

events.text: A Zhent caravan is destroyed in Teshwave, apparently by Cormyreans upset at the situation in Daggerdale.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 43

events.text: Duke Bhereu of Cormyr leads troops out of Tilverton and into the Dalelands, joining forces with Mourngrym Amcathra, lord of Shadowdale. Together, they destroy a dark elf caravan travelling near Shadowdale and help Randal Morn of Daggerdale fight off an orc incursion from the Desertsmouth Mountains.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 44

events.text: The Nentyarch of the Great Dale begins stockpiling black gemstones, sending agents across the Realms in search of them but not giving a reason why.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 43

events.text: Old Empires
The Company of the Cloak forms in Scornubel under the leadership of the minor mage Mhair Gulzrabban.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 44

events.text: Lurkan the Reaver of the Sword Coast travels to the region around the Inner Sea to lend his services to the growing conflict in the Moonsea region.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 44

events.text: Sightings of Princess Alusair Obarskyr pour into Suzail. Many are thought to be false but one, claiming her appearance in Tilverton, being seen with the lord of that city, seems credible as he too has recently disappeared.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 44

events.text: After a particularly vicious battle between the forces of Hillsfar and those of Zhentil Keep, the Hillsfar faction, led by Maalthiir, wins control of Yûlash. Zhent forces begin massing in Voonlar to strike back, and preparing for war in Zhentil Keep itself.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 44

events.text: Reports arise of strange fey creatures appearing in the Hullack Forest and the hills around Thunderholme.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 44

events.text: The Rogues of Tilverton are attacked in their own headquarters by the Fire Knives but that same contingent of Fire Knives is then defeated by an adventuring party inscribed with the Azure Bonds (which they had helped to inscribe!).

Thaalim Torchtower rises to lead the lawless men of the Tunlands between the Storm Horns and the Sunset Mountains. Rumors spread that he has spies in all the settlements of Cormyr (though in reality he only has one spy in Eagle's Peak).
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 44

events.text: Zhentil Keep's grip on the cities of the Moonsea loosens as the Zhents become distracted by warfare further south.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 44

events.text: The Stranded Fish tavern in Ordulin is destroyed when a fight breaks out between locals and a mage thought to be a Red Wizard.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 44

events.text: The Zhentilar retake Yûlash with an inferior number of troops supported by powerful magic. The troops from Hillsfar retreat from the city, allowing the Zhents time to reinforce the devastated city’s defenses.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 45

events.text: The Knights of Myth Drannor destroy the portal to Avernus located in the ruins of Myth Drannor.
cites: Dragon 359: Volo's Guide: Myth Drannor, City of Song, с. 103

events.text: Aumark Lithyl unifies Ruathym.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 40

events.text: Thayan agents openly slay merchants in both Westgate and Scardale Town.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 45

events.text: Heavy snowfall hits Cormyr and the Dalelands, up to a foot in some places. Several ships become trapped in ice on the River Lis.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 45

events.text: A mercenary company, under the leadership of Narve Dwarfkin and Ryhinn Blackcloak forms in the city of Selgaunt.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 45

events.text: Haspur, a seer in Baldur's Gate, has a vision that prophesies the rediscovery of the Ring of Winter in the near future. During his vision, he seemed very upset but could recall nothing when he broke out of his trance.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 41

events.text: The adventurer Shaless returns to her favorite tavern, the Drunken Dragon in Tsurlagol with harps and blades she had recovered from the lost city of Myth Drannor. The "identity" of two of the harps are confirmed by the bard Maerhult.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 45

events.text: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set (1st edition)
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 40–45

events.text: A caravan from Zhentil Keep is destroyed by Cormyrean warriors in Teshwave.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 43

events.text: Cormyrean soldiers engage Zhent forces in Daggerdale and Teshwave, and bolster the garrison at Castle Crag to guard against attacks from the north or opportunistic bandits.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 44

events.text: Hades War: Seeking to build an army to raise against his master Anthraxus, the Arcanaloth Yrkhetep wages war on the Prime Material against the people of Chondath and Turmish in an effort to harvest souls for the Infinity Train.
cites: Swords of the Iron Legion, с. 2

events.text: Lord Envoy Orm's desertion sparks civil war in Melvaunt, as senior families fight to control the throne.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 44

events.text: Salamander War: The Red Wizards of Thay open a gate to the Elemental Plane of Fire and begin a campaign against the North Coast cities of Escalant, Murbant, and Thasselen. Escalant is besieged by fire elementals. Finally, Escalant and Laothkund fall to the Thayans and the elementals as most of the Wizards' Reach falls under Thayan rule.
cites: Dreams of the Red Wizards, с. 23
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142,144

events.text: A second Thayan army, this one bolstered by the zombie forces of Myrkul's Legion, invades Rashemen but is turned back.
cites: Dreams of the Red Wizards, с. 59–60

events.text: Circa: A fleet of the mamluks of Qudra tries to take control of the corsair city of Hawa. The attack is beaten back with severe losses to the Qudran navy.
cites: Corsairs of the Great Sea: Campaign Guide, с. 24

events.text: An avatar of Moander wreaks terrible destruction on Yûlash when it is accidentally freed from its elven-made prison underneath the city by Alias.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142,144

events.text: Phintarn "Redblade", lord of Llorkh, is murdered.
cites: Volo's Guide to the North, с. 213

events.text: Pharaoh Akonhorus II of Mulhorand is assassinated by the Cult of Set, leaving eleven-year-old Horustep III on the throne of Mulhorand.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142,144

events.text: Autumn: Taalmuth Chaadren (father of Tsarra Chaadren) is killed in a spell battle, most likely by a lich.
Vendes Baenre, a vicious drow priestess popular in Gracklstugh for her "sculpted" ebony statues transmuted from living beings.
cites: Drizzt Do'Urden's Guide to the Underdark, с. 61

events.text: An earthquake in the vicinity of the Laughing Hollow releases an unknown pollutant into the River Delimbiyr downriver of the site. Livestock that drink from the river die in large numbers and Daggerford has to rely on its wells and cisterns for drinking water until the source of the pollution is stemmed.

A group of mindflayers place vampire squids into the Giant's Chalice as part of a long-term scheme to goad the lake's inhabitants into seeking aid from their sea elf allies so that they can enslave some.
The Fire Knives move to Westgate and base their organization at Castle Cormaeril.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition, с. 273

events.text: The dwarves of Clan Ironeater reclaim the ruined halls of Illefarn.

Shandril Shessair kills a dracolich of the Cult of the Dragon. The Sembian Cult of the Dragon cell also suffers, as Shandril costs the cell three dracoliches (Shargrailar the Dark, Rauglothgor the Proud, and Aghazstamn) and two Wearers of Purple.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142,144

events.text: In Kara-Tur, an outpost of the Black Leopard Cult on Akari Island is discovered and wiped out. As the news arrives in Pendir Chao and H'sin-to, Black Leopard followers organize large-scale parades and demonstrations.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142,144

events.text: The bandit-lord Lothchas of the Moonsea shifts his operation from that region to the Dalelands to the south.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 44

events.text: An inexperienced Harper bard named Mestrel Hawkmantle succeeds at an extraordinary amount of tasks before disappearing through a portal that he found in some ancient ruins.
cites: The Code of the Harpers, с. 14–18

events.text: Chansreena Alabhansree Alanasker of Ormpur elopes with her lover, the pirate Cairak Redbeard to the Moonshae Isles, taking several magic weapons and a large quantity of saffron with her to ensure a comfortable life.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142,144

events.text: Shaliim Wyrmslayer, the prince of Lapaliiya, and his Waterdhavian adventuring party narrowly escape capture by a group of black dragons.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142,144

events.text: Khelben "Blackstaff" Arunsun steals the Scepter of the Sorcerer-Kings from a Harper vault called the Catacombs of Ordulin. He replaces it with an illusory replica.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142,144

events.text: The bard Ivryn Olindarr writes the comedic play Three Black Horses.
Malarkin Norlbertusz of Ordulin writes the play Much Ado in Sembia.

Khelben Arunsun shatters the Crown of Horns, freeing Laeral Silverhand from Myrkul's evil influence. He returns to Blackstaff Tower in Waterdeep with her to help her heal; within three years, they are inseparable, and Laeral is often referred to as Lady Arunsun.
cites: Volo's Guide to All Things Magical, с. 101
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142,144

events.text: Thauloamur Reerist, a minstrel, writes the book Clever Words from a Failed Jester.

links.t: Clever Words from a Failed Jester

events.text: Thalamoasz Threir, Sage of Sembia, writes Signposts In The Gardens of Life.

links.t: Signposts In The Gardens of Life

events.text: Pumkato, a svirfneblin of Blingdenstone, rises to the position of burrow warden, one of the youngest in the city's history.
cites: Drizzt Do'Urden's Guide to the Underdark, с. 37

events.text: On the alternate world of Earth, Ed Greenwood collates a collection of travelogues, maps, and other information given him by Elminster into the Forgotten Realms Campaign Set for its first publication.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142,144

events.text: In the guise of the halfling Regis, the assassin Artemis Entreri comes to Mithral Hall. He battles Drizzt Do'Urden, but is defeated and left for dead. However, he is later rescued by Jarlaxle and the Bregan D'aerthe, who take him to Menzoberranzan. Later this year, while Drizzt and Catti-brie escape the city, he joins them.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142,144

events.text: Shandril Shessair, a spellfire-wielding maiden of Deepingdale, is hunted by both the Cult of the Dragon and the Zhentarim across the Dalelands and Cormyr and into the Heartlands. On the way, she is aided by the Knights of Myth Drannor and hidden by Elminster, Mirt, and the Seven Sisters. She slays three dracoliches of the Dragon Cult.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142,144

events.text: Shandril Shessair later kills a clone of Manshoon, collapses Irondrake Rock, slays the lichnee Iliph Thraun and does heavy damage to Zhentil Keep and the Citadel of the Raven with spellfire.
The Dragon Cult and Zhentarim continue to hunt Shandril, until finally she immolates herself in spellfire.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142,144

events.text: Heading to Silverymoon at the invitation of Alustriel, Drizzt Do'Urden comes across the path of a band of orc and ogre raiders and their captives. Joining with a band of farmers from Pengallen, they defeat the band, though not before one of the slaves—a goblin named Nojheim—escapes. Having been told the goblin was a captured war band leader who was to have a trial, Drizzt tracks him down and returns him, whereupon he learns that Nojheim is as temperamentally different a goblin as Drizzt is a drow, and a slave owned by Rico Pengallen. Traveling to Silverymoon to appeal to Alustriel's justice, Drizzt isn't there to stop Nojheim's owner from killing him.
cites: Realms of Valor: Dark Mirror, с. 302–334

events.text: Alias and Dragonbait track down the makers of the Azure Bonds. In the process, they destroy the evil magician Cassana of Westgate, the lich Zrie Prakis, the Fire Knives guild, and the fiend Phalse, and they ban the god of decay Moander from Faerûn.
On the island of Shinkoku in Kozakura, Lady Sato Kitashi befriended several li lung dragons.
cites: Kara-Tur: The Eastern Realms: Volume II, с. 138

events.text: Orm, the Lord Envoy of the Council of Lords of Melvaunt, flees the city with most of the treasury and buys himself an estate north of Zhentil Keep. The Zhents recognize him as the true lord of Melvaunt regardless.
Rumors of a merchant's or nobles' war breaking out in Westgate begin to spread in the nation of Cormyr. Several dead assassins turn up dead in the harbor of the city.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 43
Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 44

events.text: Moonsea caravans sending supplies to Zhent troops in the Dalelands begin quietly changing their destination to Arabel. Zhentil Keep quickly discovers this treachery and abandons support for its occupying forces, instead concentrating on rebuilding Yûlash in an attempt to divert all Moonsea trade away from the Dalelands.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 43

events.text: During the months of Flamerule, Eleasias, and Eleint, the Night Masks battle the Shore Patrol for control of Westgate's criminal underworld. Adventurers, hired by the city's merchant nobility as bounty hunters, deliver a sharp check to the ambitions of the Night Masks. Their efforts thwart a plot by the ruling Pentad of Night Masters to transform Westgate into a theocracy of Mask, the Shadowlord.
Waterdeep mediates a truce between Luskan and Ruathym. However, Luskan and Ruathym, together with Tuern and the Whalebones, subsequently make an alliance to raid settlements down the Sword Coast.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142,144

events.text: Netyarch Zalathorm is replaced on the throne of Halruaa by Elder Gabrela for two weeks while he recovers from a particularly disturbing divination concerning the events of the year to come.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142,144

events.text: Slave riots in Messemprar.
A tribe of kobolds takes up residence in the Maiden's Tomb Tor, unnoticed by Waterdeep.
cites: The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier: The Wilderness, с. 49

events.text: Lady Alustriel forges an alliance with Bruenor Battlehammer of Mithral Hall and helps defend the dwarf halls against the drow of House Baenre.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142,144

events.text: Circa: Geildarr becomes lord of Llorkh after the murder of Phintarn "Redblade", the previous lord. Dwarves start disappearing in Llorkh.
The wizard Maalthir launched a successful coup d'etat against the Council of Hillsfar.
Zhengyi the Witch-King divides Damara, claiming the northern resource-rich duchies for himself and leaving the southern baronies as squabbling puppet states.
This year is known as the Year of Spell Flames in the Black Chronology.
cites: Cormyr: The Tearing of the Weave, с. 159
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 157

events.text: This year is known as the Year of the Great Sky Serpent in Shou Lung.
cites: Kara-Tur: The Eastern Realms: Volume I, с. 3

events.text: The "present" in the Forgotten Realms Campaign Set is Nightal 30, 1357 Dalereckoning.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: Cyclopedia of the Realms, с. 4

events.text: Citta Hothemer publishes the book Musings of a Shameless Noble.
cites: The Temptation of Elminster: Paperback 1999, с. 93

events.text: Rumors are rampant in the lands east of Waterdeep that a new Beast Lord, a term given to those who breed rare, dangerous monsters such as owlbears and gorgimera, has arisen, as monsters associated with such men are suddenly increasing in number and seem to be working in concert.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 41

events.text: The King's Tournament is held at the Fields of Pryollus to determine the successor of King Theris of Mourktar.
Gauntlgrym is re-discovered by the Company of the Gryphon.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 41
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142,144

events.text: The corpses of six illithid and thirteen drow are found washing down the Unicorn Run in Secomber all killed by fire or blade.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 41

events.text: Large bands of orcs are reported to be on the move between Baldur's Gate and Amn. They are avoiding contact and moving stealthily.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 41

events.text: Waterdeep puts a high premium on juvenile griffons and their eggs when Open Lord Piergeiron being bolstering the numbers of their Griffon Cavalry.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 41

events.text: Unknown creatures are reported being seen in the Yuirwood. Those who attempt to combat them are not seen again.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 42

events.text: The House of Gond opens in Essembra, led by the Lord High Smith Gulmarin Reldacap.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 42

events.text: During the Festival of the Assumption, Gilgeam destroys a giant dragon turtle in Unthalass Harbor.
Mourngrym Amcathra and Randal Morn (supported by the garrison at Tilverton) commit forces to clear the trade roads from Shadowdale and Mistledale to Cormyr.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 43

events.text: Azoun IV orders the search of all travelers in Cormyr after he discovers gems from the royal mine are being smuggled out of the country.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 43

events.text: The Sceptanar of Cimbar sends an envoy to Cormyr, Sembia, and the Dalelands, seeking information on the attack on Scornubel by a nishruu in 1355 DR. He offers great wealth to whoever can send the specimen trapped under his palace back to its home plane without harming the magic or people of his realm (and greater wealth to whoever can make it work for him).
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 43

events.text: A well-known dancer from the Grey Veil in Zhentil Keep disappears, supposedly in possession of Yuthla, the Eye of the Beholder.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 43

events.text: Tyranthraxus learns of the process of inscribing Azure Bonds. The Possessing Spirit forms an alliance with a Red wizard, some Zhentarim mages and the survivors of the previous attempt at using the Azure Bonds (Fire Knives members and cultists of Moander). They abduct a group of adventurers and inscribe them with the Bonds.

After being banished from Amn for threatening to kill other merchants with magical creatures he controls or conjures from his home in Murann, Shairkash moves to the town of Beregost. He begins threatening competing traders just as he did in the Merchant's Nation.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 44

events.text: The adventurers abducted by the New Alliance of the Bonds wake up in Tilverton during a visit from Azoun IV. The brands force them to attack the king's carriage but they escape retaliation, going on to rescue Alusair Obarskyr and Giogi Wyvernspur. They then free themselves of the Azure Bonds and destroy Tyranthraxus with a little help from Elminster.
The flying ship Blue Diamond is spotted in the skies above the Vilhon Reach.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 45

events.text: Slaver activity is discovered in the Elven Court.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 45

cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Set: DM's Sourcebook of the Realms, с. 45

Mulhorand sends a fleet to seize the Alaor from Thay, but over half the fleet sinks as a result of storms and sahuagin attacks, and the campaign ends in failure. For the remainder of the year, Mulhorand defends against sahuagin attacks on its port cities.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: The Summer Storms War leaves many sahuagin of the Alamber and two-thousand Mulhorandi dead with over thirty ships destroyed.

House Oblodra (with its psionic powers unaffected by the Time of Troubles) plots to seize power over the drow city of Menzoberranzan. However, as the Troubles end, they are defeated and destroyed by House Baenre.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: Led by House Baenre, an army of drow, goblins, and kobolds of Menzoberranzan attack Mithril Hall. The dwarves are joined by local barbarian tribes, svirfneblin, the forces of Nesmé and Silverymoon, as well as Lady Alustriel Silverhand and the Harpells of Longsaddle. Together, they defeat the drow and force them back underground.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: Nesmé is attacked by the Griffon tribe in Eleint and surrenders to them in Uktar.
An army of sycamore trees besieges Suzail, capital of Cormyr.
The mythal barrier around Myth Nantar withstands attempts to break it.
A horde of goblins descend from the High Peaks and Kuldin Peaks to engulf Erlkazar, but the realm defends itself.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: The Battle of Ascore occurs, and ruins the Zhentarim plan to expand their territory westwards.
In Cormyr, fighting for control of the legendary family heirloom the Wyvernspur, Flattery Wyvernspur is slain in battle with Giogi Wyvernspur.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: The beholder crime lord Xanathar is slain by adventurers under the command of the Lords of Waterdeep. Halaster Blackcloak, the Mad Mage of Undermountain, seems to have had a hand in this.
cites: Dungeon 206: The Xanathar: Crime Lord of Waterdeep

events.text: Malruthiia Chaadren, mother of Tsarra Chaadren, is killed defending the Elfstone Tavern from Myrkul's horde.
In the Battle of Keeper's Dale, many good folk are killed when the drow horde attacks Mithral Hall, including Knight in Silver Besnell, the svirfneblin Firble, and the Harpell wizard Regweld Harpell.
cites: Cite book: Siege of Darkness: Paperback (1995), с. 330

events.text: Neveren Darkdance, leader of House Darkdance in Westgate, dies.
The evil enchantress Cortarra was killed in a battle against the Heroes of Ascore.
King Theris of Mourktar with no heir, leaving his city in the hands of Impterceptor Kabbarath Telthaug.
Obril Matrell of Arrabar's noble merchant House Matrell dies on Eleint 18.
cites: The Sapphire Crescent: House Matrell Family Tree

events.text: Mourngrym and Shaerl Amcathra, lord and lady of Shadowdale, have a son, Scothgar "Scotti" Amcathra.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 80

events.text: Myrin Darkdance, a mage who was later imprisoned in a pocket of Spellplague for nearly 100 years, is born.

The Time of Troubles begins as the gods are cast out of the planes by Lord Ao and forced to wander Toril as mortals. They must retrieve and return the stolen Tablets of Fate. Magic turns to chaos and prayers go unanswered. The Time of Troubles see the destruction of the deities Bane, Bhaal, Myrkul, Torm, Mystra, Leira, Moander, Ibrandul, Ramman, Tiamat, and Gilgeam and the rise of the mortals Cyric, Midnight, and Finder Wyvernspur to godhood. The Untheric pantheon is dissolved.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: Amidst a rain of fire, Bane's spirit falls from the sky and directly onto the Black Altar, his temple in Zhentil Keep, in an event known there as The Arrival.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: Some of the energy released when Bane, Bhaal, and Myrkul are slain combines to form a race of forsaken beings called the kir-lanan.
At the end of the Time of Troubles, Ao restores Torm to godhood.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: Gilgeam kills Tiamat. Tiamat's deific essence is split into three pieces, one of which inhabits the red dragon Tchazzar. The reborn Tiamat then slays Gilgeam, as their battle causes great destruction to the city of Unthalass.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: The god Hoar, also known as Assuran, kills the god Ramman, putting an end to the Untheric pantheon.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: The demi-power Malyk appears in the Underdark following Mystra's destruction.

Waukeen entrusts her divinity to her goddess friend Lliira and escapes the Realms, travelling to the Astral Plane with the help of a god from another world. However, she is soon betrayed and imprisoned in the Abyss by the arch-demon Graz'zt.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: Lady Kaitlin Tindall Bloodhawk is inhabited by the avatar of the Red Knight during the Time of Troubles. Through her, the Red Knight assists in stopping a horde of monsters from the Forest of Tethir from invading Tethyr.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: Shar captures and imprisons Selûne and masquerades as her. Selûne's faithful rescue her, foiling Shar's plans. Shar's followers flee to Vanrakdoom.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: Sekolah, Anhur, and Umberlee, along with lesser gods of water, appear in the Inner Sea, resulting in disturbances to the underwater region of Serôs.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: In the Inner Sea, Umberlee batters the Pirate Isles with hurricanes and storms, obliterating over two-thirds of the pirates' fleets. In the Trackless Sea, Umberlee adopts Slarkrethel as her Chosen.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: Moander returns to the Forgotten Vale and seizes control of the settlement of saurials. However, he is forced back into the planes by Alias, Dragonbait, and others along with the "Nameless Bard" Finder Wyvernspur. Finder destroys Moander and becomes a demi-power himself.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: Sseth's avatar makes a brief appearance over the Lapal Sea, and then battles Ubtao's dinosaur avatar on the eastern side of the jungles of Chult.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: The sarrukh of Okoth meet with the divine minions of Set. They agree to bind their god Sseth into everlasting sleep in exchange for magic and assistance to help them in their war against the khaasta.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: The avatars of the deities Clangeddin Silverbeard and Labelas Enoreth clash on Ruathym, turning the island into a battleground.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: Malar tries to creep into the Gulthmere Forest to prey upon the druids there. Nobanion stops him in a battle known as the Roar of Shadows and drives him away to the north-west, toward the Sword Coast.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: Silvanus is sighted exploring the Winterwood and the depths of the Chondalwood. He is also said to have bestowed a special blessing upon the island of Ilighôn, the base of the Emerald Enclave and his Chosen.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: The demigod Kalzareinad dies after the goddess Kereska subsumed his portfolio and worshipers.
On Mount Waterdeep, at the end of the Time of Troubles, Myrkul is destroyed and Midnight ascends to become the new Mystra.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: Ao brings down the Imaskari planar barrier, which allows the manifestations of the Mulhorandi pantheon to leave Toril and reunite with their divine essences.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: After the Avatar Crisis, Cyric and Mask murder Leira, though her faith claim she faked her own death in a grand illusion.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: Dead magic and wild magic areas appear in the Realms.
The winter is one of the coldest and snowiest in memory. Frost giants wander as far south as Longsaddle.
An unusual hurricane destroys the granite lighthouse known as Hezemdell's Beacon on Mezeketh Isle off the coast of Saerloon.
The walls, ceiling, and floor of Beggar's Rest Pass in Skullport reportedly liquefied without warning.
The Order of the Silver Chalice is founded in Waterdeep.
The Jaezred Chaulssin discover the existence of Nurvureem, daughter of their Patron Grandfather's kidnapped mate and thought to be the only female "drow-dragon".
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: Under cover of the Time of Troubles, a host of malaugrym arrive in Faerûn with plans to infiltrate Faerûnian society and kill and replace many important people, as well as kill Elminster. However, the majority of malaugrym and defeated and killed, a few fleeing to parts unknown.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: With Myrkul's death, the Ebondeath Sect of the Mere of Dead Men falls apart.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: Thanks to the machinations of the gods Bane and Myrkul, the deaths of Bhaal and many assassins see the Shadow Thieves of Amn lose two-thirds of their assassin membership and their entire Shade Council. They extensively restructure.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: The Toril thirteen, a warlock coven, performs a ritual to bind most of the known tiefling lineages to the "blood of Asmodeus", changing their original lineage with that of the archdevil himself. This was done to make Asmodeus a "racial deity", ensuring him enough followers to attain godly powers. The effort ultimately proves fruitless, however.
Zahara's Krakens, a chaotic good mercenary company, made their presence known along the Sword Coast.

The Calishite mage Shond Tharovin releases the demilich Qysar Shoon VII upon Zallanora Argentresses, a young female elf mage. The minds of Shoon VII and Zallanora are exchanged, each trapped in the other's body.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: The Wandering Seed of the Goddess Wilaundaun Braer, Patriarch of Chauntea, disappears somewhere in the Fallen Lands or south of Weathercote Wood. The Glarathra vanishes with him.
Niko went to hunt with eight male friends. They were however all captured by bakemono followers of the Earth Spider. All her friends were killed but Niko was spared.
The fledgling wizard Keane arrives in Callidyrr to join the Council of Sorcerers.
Following the Godswar, the priesthood of Waukeen loses its hold over the city of Nesmé.
cites: The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier: The Wilderness, с. 75

events.text: The Lords' Alliance of Waterdeep applies diplomatic and military pressure on Luskan, forcing them to remove their occupying forces from the island of Ruathym. Meanwhile, Luskan and the allied island nations of the Trackless Sea join in the Captain's Confederation.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

events.text: In Unther, the battle of Gilgeam and Tiamat causes great destruction to the city of Unthalass, and the death of Ramman sees the end of the Untheric pantheon. People riot across the empire as it falls into strife.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 142

According to Harper reports, during the summer of this year the ancestral mound of every Uthgardt tribe was breached by lizardmen and they left behind strange totems at each mound.
This year is known as the Year of Ascension in the Black Chronology.

Gareth Dragonsbane becomes Baron of Bloodstone, and invites the ire and envy of other Damaran barons and dukes when he brings one million gold pieces worth of bloodstone to market in Heliogabalus following his reclamation of the Bloodstone Mines.
Bahamut regains his status as a deity after Gareth Dragonsbane plants the Tree-Gem and mortals begin to worship the platinum dragon once more.
Set attacks and imprisons Sseth, adopting Sseth's guise to gain the worship of his serpentfolk followers.
cites: Dragon 313: Faiths of Faerun: Elder Serpents of Set, с. 85

events.text: Gareth Dragonsbane becomes King of Damara before the end of the year.
cites: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition, с. 108

events.text: The Lords of Nimbral forbid organized priesthoods and state religions from being practiced in their realm, prompting many Leiran (now Cyricist) priests to move to Samarach.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: The people of Unther force the high priests of Gilgeam out of Unthalass. The priests and Unther's military leads retreat to the Citadel of Black Ash.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: The ambitious Yamun Khahan leads the Tuigan Horde out of the Hordelands to conquer Khazari and the Semphar. Next, he breaches the Dragonwall and launches an invasion of Shou Lung. Following months of heated fighting, a truce is declared, and Yamun turns westward.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: Thay is next to be invaded by the Tuigan Horde. Thayan magic overcomes the first scouting foray, but the Tuigan general Batu Min Ho leads a more effective assault. The Tuigans defeat the famous Griffon Legion and thousands of gnolls at Shar's Pass. Zulkir Szass Tam negotiates peace with the Tuigans, then constructs a huge portal to transport them to Thay's enemy, Rashemen.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: Invading Rashemen via portal, the Tuigans lay siege to Citadel Rashemar and destroy it, while their main force cross the High Country to assault the Rashemi gathering at the Lake of Tears. Meanwhile, a Thayan army traps a force of Rashemi berserkers south of Lake Mulsantir, preventing them from aiding their countrymen. The Witches can only slow the Tuigan Horde.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: Ixitxachitl seize parts of the northeastern Hmur Plateau, but are driven out before year is over.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: Thousands of refugees fleeing the Tuigan Horde cross Lake Ashane. Some travel to Uthmere and settle along the Great Road, where they become known as "the newcomers".
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: A dark naga from the Slitherswamp level of Undermountain discovers a portal that allows the nagas and ophidians there to travel back to Najara, where they were abducted from seventy years prior.
Zhengyi, the Witch-King of Vaasa, is slain.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: Urshula the Black is killed, and his soul trapped in a phylactery.
cites: The Collected Stories: The Legend of Drizzt Anthology: Paperback 2011: If Ever They Happened Upon My Lair

events.text: Gareth Dragonsbane and his adventuring companions steal and destroy the Wand of Orcus in the blood of an avatar of Tiamat, thwarting her plans. They leave the Abyss and return to Damara, with the blessings of Bahamut. There they plant the Tree-Gem, which becomes a symbol of the covenant between Bahamut and Damara. It also solidifies Gareth's rule as king of Damara.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144
Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3rd edition, с. 108

events.text: Lord Pundun and his mage mentor, Menrick, release the vampire Shyressa in a mausoleum outside Dajaan.
In Calimport, Myrmeen Lhal battles and exposes the Night Parade.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: Duskar Flamehaern, the proprietor of Adderposts in Essembra, and his family come under the sway of a spirit naga named Ssensariith. A snake cult forms around the naga and Duskar begins selling drugs and captured slaves out of the building.
The Coiled Cabal break through Netherese wards to enter the ruins of Ss'thar'tiss'ssun, summoning guardian creatures from the Chultan Peninsula.
The Order of the Silver Chalice is formed in the month of Alturiak.

The Risen Cult of Bane arrives in the Moonshae Isles with bandits and undead. They manage to infiltrate Caer Callidyrr and try to kidnap the High King. A group of adventurers, Harpers and the archmage Flamsterd save the King's life after defeating an avatar of Iyachtu Xvim.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 29

events.text: Arvoreen's Marchers form in Tethyr to patrol and protect the Purple Marches.
The Emerald Brotherhood are abducted by illithids and taken into Realmspace for a second time.
cites: Lands of Intrigue: Erlkazar and Folk of Intrigue, с. 3

events.text: Vorthryn's Archivir is taken from its resting place and finds its way into the hands of an untold number of adventurers. From Neverwinter to Zazesspur and Athkatla to Alaghôn, the book is incredibly useful to those who wield it and it serves to convert many to Azuth's faith.
Members of non-dragon humanoid races begin to hear the call of Bahamut, and many of undergo the Rite of Rebirth, transforming themselves into dragonborn of Bahamut.
At the direction of Lady Merelith, a new lighthouse is built on Mezeketh Isle off the coast of Saerloon and Zembrath Klun is put in charge.
This year is known as the Year of the Carnival in the Black Chronology.
cites: Cormyr: The Tearing of the Weave, с. 159
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 157

Mount Ugruth experiences minor volcanic activity and makes some slight rumbling. This is enough to briefly open a portal to the Elemental Plane of Fire, through dozens of magmins escape into the volcano's chamber.

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

The Battle of the Lake of Tears force the Tuigans into retreat, but the Rashemi do not follow as the Red Wizards of Thay part the water of Lake Ashane so the Tuigans may cross.

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: The Tuigan Horde invading Thesk is defeated at Phsant by a united army led by Azoun IV.

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

events.text: The necromancer Kelshara steals the Tear of Everard from Everard Abbey. The warrior-turned-priest Tyveris recovers it after defeating her.

Adon and Corene, both priests of Mystra, travel to the cursed town of Tegea at the urging of their goddess. Despite discovering that Duke Gorgias had laid a ward upon the town making it difficult for clerics' prayers to reach the divine realms, they manage to defeat him. With the ward mostly broken, Adon opens a temple to Mystra.
cites: Realms of Valor: The Curse of Tegea

events.text: Abet-Khrul leads a fleet of twenty four galleys full of pirates against the Golden Legion. Captain Cordell is victorious, and the pirate's defeat ensures Asavir's Channel is safe for merchant traffic for years to come.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 29

events.text: Akanna, priestess of Cyric, kills Bhaalists and seizes their temple in the Forest of Wyrms for her deity's cult.
Talona commands Castle Trinity in Erlkazar to begin its campaign of conquest.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 145

events.text: Talos begins a five year campaign of sending storms, drought, and worse weather against the Moonshae Isles.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 29

events.text: Alusair Obarskyr is reunited with her father.
Yamun Khahan of the Tuigan Horde dies in single combat against King Azoun IV of Cormyr.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 144

events.text: A series of murders shakes Arabel. Several prominent wizards and miscellaneous spell-caster are targeted by the Night Parade. Artos Malabar, Epicot, and Myschanta Halarra are slain. Myschanta is resurrected by Alustriel Silverhand several days later. Zhentarim is blamed for the deaths.
A group of saurial slaves are taken to Tarkhaldale by the god Moander. They later break free and establish a settlement in the dale.
The Second Unhuman War spreads to Realmspace as a coalition between the Elven Imperial Fleet and the spelljammer fleet from Evermeet fights to repel a scro invasion over several battles.
An ancient fang dragon named Nartheling moves into the mountain Umbergoth in Aglarond.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 145

events.text: A gang of pirates briefly recovers Shanatar's Wyrmskull Throne in the Bay of Skulls near Hook Isle, but then lose it again.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 145

events.text: The Pasha's Palace, a massive, steel-reinforced, magically warded warship intended to be the terror of the seas is sunk five hours into its maiden voyage by a kraken.
cites: Empires of the Shining Sea, с. 89

events.text: The Wyvern Crown of Cormyr is stolen by Zhent agents led by the famed thief Nith. He loses it in a region of wild magic in the Helmlands.
cites: Volo's Guide to All Things Magical, с. 122

events.text: One night in summer, a woman, clad in nothing but a falcon-head carnival mask, is observed walking from the City of the Dead in Waterdeep to that city’s south gate holding high what appears to be the real Silver Supplicant when only fakes have been seen for the last 200 years.
This year is known as the Year of Armies in the Black Chronology.
cites: Cormyr: The Tearing of the Weave, с. 159
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 157

events.text: Zhentarim wizard Pontifel is targeted by the Night Parade. To save his life, he agrees to remove all Black Network operations from Arabel for a decade. The agreement is signed and delivered to King Azoun Obarskyr IV.

The Night Parade kick off a plot to open a gate into the Demiplane of Nightmares to conquer Arabel and assassinate Myrmeen Lhal and her adopted daughter Krystin. The plot is stopped by a group of adventurers and several members of the Night Parade are slain.

Lolth sends a yochlol to Menzoberranzan during a sacrifice of a drow male. The handmaiden decrees the new laws of the Spider Queen. There should be peace among all houses, no drow must be sacrificed, even males and children should be treated well. All this is to strengthen the city after the turmoil and losses of the recent past. Until Lolth declares the end of this peace, every house that breaks these rules will be punished by her. The yochlol also named the new twenty strongest houses of the city.

events.text: In the Sea of Fallen Stars, Teldar becomes King of the Pirates.

The followers of Cyric seize control of Zhentil Keep. Xeno Mirrormane leads an inquisition/holy war known as the First Banedeath in an effort to scour the city of the existing Bane worshipers. They given the option to worship Cyric or die.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

events.text: The Chosen of Eilistraee from the Promenade has skirmishes with and attacks the Dragon's Hoard merchant company's headquarters in Skullport.
Castle Trinity, led by Barjin and later Aballister Bonaduce, begins their quest for regional conquest.
Luskan conquers Ruathym again, but the Lords' Alliance threatens war and forces a withdrawal.

events.text: Cordell's Golden Legion conquers Payit, Kultaka, and Nexal in Maztica. They take over the city of Ulatos.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

events.text: Four archmages of the Cult of the Dragon come to Silverymoon and hurl spells to provoke Alustriel Silverhand to confront them. Alustriel and Taern "Thunderspell" Hornblade destroy two of the archmages, but a Cult dracolich then assaults the southern walls. Taern and the Spellguard deal with the dracolich, leaving Alustriel to face the remaining archmages alone. She slays one, but only the fortuitous arrival of Khelben "Blackstaff" Arunsun and Laeral Silverhand save her life against the last.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

events.text: Tammar in Thesk is seized by Tuigan bandits, who harass merchants on the Golden Way for months.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

events.text: Tan Chin leads his undead forces into Shou Lung. Still weak from the Tuigan Horde two years before, the Shou are overrun at Shih Tuh and Yenching. Tan Chin then takes Lo Tu, then the whole realm of Khazari by the end of the year.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

events.text: The Monastery of St Domin is dedicated to Ilmater in Tethyr, about a half-day north of where the path from Mosstone ended at the coast.
cites: Volo's Guide to Baldur's Gate II, с. 99

events.text: Barjin, the cleric of Talona, plans to destroy the Edificant Library, but is killed by Cadderly Bonaduce.
Ragnor, a half-ogre from Castle Trinity, is killed by Elbereth and Cadderly Bonaduce.
The assassin Ghost of Westgate, is defeated by Cadderly Bonaduce. He is officially defeated in a mental battle with Cadderly in some abyssal rift.
Galladel, an elven king of Shilmista, is killed during the invasion by Castle Trinity's forces. His son, Elbereth, becomes the new king.
Bogo Rath, one of the three wizards of Castle Trinity, is killed by Ivan Bouldershoulder after a failed attempt to escape from Cadderly Bonaduce when his assassination plans fall to pieces.
Zz'Pzora, a two-headed deep dragon, is killed in the lair of the Dragon's Hoard merchant company beneath Skullport.
Naltecona, the last ruler of Nexal, is killed by Cordell's mage and lover Darien, setting off the Night of Wailing.
The Amnnian Bishop of Helm, Domincus is sacrificed to the Maztican god Zaltec in Nexal.
Cordell's cavalry commander Alvarro is poisoned when he attempts to rape a priestess of Qotal.
The wizard Xonthal dies from unknown means.

After convincing the Righteous Man, guildmaster of the Night Knives' thieves' guild of Selgaunt, to have guild members infiltrate the homes of several noble families in order to gain actionable information, Erevis Cale assassinates the butler of the Uskevren family and then convinces Thamalon Uskevren to hire him as the man's replacement.
A former Sembian nobleman named Dinam becomes a dukar after falling overboard from his ship and losing his memory.
Arilyn Moonblade and Danilo Thann discover that the Harper Assassin terrorizing the North is the gold elf Kymil Nimesin. Danilo joins the Harpers.

The Maztican god Zaltec manifests in the form of a giant stone statue. He leads an army of orcs and ogres to the Twin Visages and then later battles the avatar of Qotal. When it appears that the gods' battle would destroy Maztica, both avatars are banished back to the outer planes by the high priest of Qotal.
Mintar is conquered by Teldorn Darkhope and the Church of Bane.
An assassin of the highest order is sent from the School of Stealth to stop Arilyn Moonblade and Danilo Thann from warning Pasha Balik of a plan to overthrow him.
A mixed army of native Mazticans, desert dwarves, wild halflings, and members of the Golden Legion defeats an army of orcs and ogres in the second battle of Ulatos.

The presence of the elder brain of Ch'Chitl is discovered on the Astral Plane by githyanki explorers and attacked, forcing it to shift entirely to the Prime Material Plane. Thalynsar, the only ulitharid in the city, absorbs its accumulated knowledge and powers with the aid of a group of alhoon necromancers, transforming him into an ulitharilich.

events.text: Thay launches an invasion of Rashemen via Thesk and the Golden Way. The Witches of Rashemen summon water elementals that wipe out the Thayan force. The Thayans retreat, but literally scorch the earth down to bare rock around the western shore of Rashemen.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

events.text: Deciding to deal with Tuigan bandits lingering after the Tuigan Horde, the Merchants' Council of Phsant sends 100 orc warriors left behind by the Zhentarim during the Crusade against the Horde. The savage orcs hunt down and kill every one of the Tuigan.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

events.text: The Witches work to repair the damage inflicted by the Thayans on the western shore of Rashemen.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

events.text: Refugees from Nexal establish the city of Tukan in the House of Tezca desert.
In Maztica, tlincalli Divivers begin a complicated a mass ritual with the intention of teleporting as many warriors as possible to Faerûn. The ritual is completed three years later.
Using spoils of war from the Tuigan War, Zaranda Star purchases County Morninggold and its keep from the Order of the Silver Chalice to help fund their operations in restoring nobility in the land.
The Rotting Man, a servant of Talona, appears in the Rawlinswood.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

events.text: At the request of the illusionist Drollo, Galvin tracks down the old mage's great-granddaughter, Isabelle, whom he finds deep in the Sea of Fallen Stars in a sea elven contraption known as a mechanical water spider.
The sage Koja plans to publish his history of the Tuigan war with Cormyr, titled A History of the Tuigan.

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

The Banite temples that will soon be known as the Twin Towers of the Eternal Eclipse are taken by Cyricists and reconsecrated.

events.text: The Council of Six of Amn is wracked by the Council Schism. Thayze Selemchant, Meisarch of Amn, dies and is replaced by the new Meisarch, Erlranther Alibakkar. Phaan Colwyvv is the new Tessarch, Qar Jysstev the new Namarch, Rhinnom Dannihyr the new Iltarch, Tyrda Q'Helvor the new Pommarch, and Pehllus Tanislove the new Dahaunarch.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

events.text: As Selemchant was an ally of Syl-Pasha Ralan el Pesarkhal of Calimshan, Ralan's plans to conquer Tethyr are put on hold.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

events.text: Maligor, the Zulkir of Alteration of the Red Wizards, tries to seize control of Thay from the Council of Zulkirs by taking over the country's gold production. Harper agents and Szass Tam, Zulkir of Necromancy, intervene and foil Maligor's scheme.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

events.text: Bruenor Battlehammer abdicates as Eighth King of Mithral Hall, leaving the throne to the restored Gandalug Battlehammer, now both First King and Ninth King.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

events.text: Tan Chin is slain by adventurers wielding the Stone Scepter of Shih, in the catacombs under Skarou.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

events.text: Aballister Bonaduce is killed by his son, Cadderly Bonaduce. Castle Trinity is abandoned.
The drider Darien is killed by the high priest of Qotal.
Willeth Lionson, the tharchion of Thaymount and Thayvian gold mines was tortured to death by Maligor and fed to the zulkir's gnolls.
Maligor, the Zulkir of Alteration in Thay perished in the Thayvian gold mines' collapsed tunnels after a failed attempt to take over Thay's economy.

Rodolpho Wianar, a cousin of Eles Wianar, the Lord of Arrabar, is killed by a crossbow bolt. The masked assassin flees the scene of the crime and is never captured. Not so coincidentally, Xaphira Matrell mysteriously disappears and is presumed dead.
cites: The Sapphire Crescent: House Matrell Family Tree

events.text: Xakamt, a beholder, is slain while attempting to invade the Flaming Brazier temple in Bezantur. However, it persists as a flaming doomsphere bound to serve the temple's high priest, Mythalanir.
Seldig, a young Blingdenstone svirfneblin, is given the responsibilities of a burrow warden.
cites: Drizzt Do'Urden's Guide to the Underdark, с. 38

Devils emerge from portals in Dragonspear Castle and gather an army of ogres, kobolds, orcs, all kinds of goblinoids, and a black dragon. In the Second Dragonspear War, the Hordes of Dragonspear overrun and destroy the village of Way Inn and its namesake, before moving to attack Daggerford. The Hordes are defeated in the Battle of Daggerford by a hastily made alliance of dwarves, elves from the Misty Forest, paladins of Ilmater, mercenaries, local militia, and a troop of the City Guard of Waterdeep.

cites: The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier: The Wilderness, с. 42

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

events.text: The Edificant Library is attacked by Kierkan Rufo, reinforced by the Chaos Curse. All its inhabitants die or turn into vampires. Soon, the Edificant Library is destroyed by Cadderly, and Spirit Soaring is built in its place.

Artus Cimber finds the Ring of Winter in the temple of Ubtao in the reappeared city of Mezro in the jungles of Chult. He uses it to help defeat an army of goblins led by the Cult of Frost, who were attacking Mezro in order to capture the Ring.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146

The famed explorer Alkazaar arrives in Candlekeep to tell tales of his exploits and to donate two books about them to the library: Alkazaar's Thrilling Tales and Alkazaar's Appendix.

Following the disappearance of Lord Bron in mid-Hammer, Iriaebor is taken over by the Zhentarim, who install Lord Cutter as their puppet in mid-Hammer. Cutter's rule is harsh and unstable and Iriaebor is later reclaimed by adventurers by mid-Marpenoth. Bron returns to power.

In Waterdeep, droughts, increased monster activity, and political unrest plague the city in the months before Midsummer. A green dragon named Grimnoshtadrano, the Riddling Dragon of the High Forest, and a mad bard and ex-Harper named Iriador "Garnet" Wintermist disrupt Shieldmeet, which nearly upsets the Lord's Rule.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146–147

events.text: Lord Uthrain of the Great Dale is killed in what is believed to be a hunting accident. Lord Uthlain inherits the throne after his father. Although the death is initially blamed on rangers in the Forest of Lethyr, a band of adventurers discovers the real killers to be agents of the Shadowmasters of Telflamm, who were working to destabilize Uthmere.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146–147

events.text: Telflamm is occupied by the Sharkjaws, a pirate fleet commanded by Evgruth the Red. Evgruth extorts huge sums from the merchant's council to spare Telflamm's trade.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146–147

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146–147

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146–147

events.text: Wulfgar, long held captive by the demon Errtu and thought dead by his friends, is released from the Abyss and returned to Faerûn. He rejoins the Companions of the Hall, and they banish Errtu from the world and back to the Abyss again.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146–147

events.text: The Companions journey to Spirit Soaring hoping that Cadderly might be able to finally destroy Crenshinibon, the Crystal Shard.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146–147

events.text: The evil power of the Shadowstar corrupts Caledan Caldorien, a Harper, and begins to transform him into the Shadowking. Caledan releases three shadevari servants. His former adventuring companions destroy the creatures, save Caledan, and prevent the Shadowking's return.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146–147

events.text: The Masked Lady of Selgaunt, a mysterious socialite who has never shown her face in nine years of living there, foils an attempted robbery on her person during a party. She is shot at when her mask is removed and all assembled think her (incorrectly) to be a mind flayer. She survives the attack and jumps off a balcony, never to be seen again. Her true species is debated for years to come.
The husband of Selantha mysteriously vanishes during a trading mission.
Amn establishes a second colony further inland in Maztica, named Qoral after an old native town nearby. Their purpose is to develop trade between New Amn and the natives of the west.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146–147

events.text: The first ships from Faerûn not from Amn dock at Helmsport in Maztica.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146–147

events.text: Failed explorations and attacks by wild elves reduce the number of Flaming Fist mercenaries in Helmsport by two-thirds. The Flaming Fist later builds Fort Flame north of Kultaka, but it remains under siege.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146–147

events.text: Borlin of the Iron House inspires a large number of dwarven warriors to form the Mithril Legion and embark on a quest to reclaim the lost Mines of Tethyamar, near the Dalelands. They march out of Tilverton, travel north-west, but are not heard from again. In fact, their assault is successful, but the army is lost and wiped out.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 146–147

events.text: The sultan of Hafayah is poisoned. In the following bloody conflict most of his children are killed, too, leaving under-age Prince Saba as ruler, with Father Uqban min Najm acting as regent.
cites: Land of Fate: Adventurer's Guide to Zakhara, с. 71–72

events.text: The sage Terithus of Athkatla publishes the chapbook Red Her Valor, about the heroics of the Red Knight as a mortal during the Time of Troubles.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 143

cites: The Temptation of Elminster: Paperback 1999, с. 117

It is eventually lost.

events.text: Thay invades Aglarond. One Thayan army advances on the fortress of Emmech, while a second heads south to the Shyvar Pass. Aglarondan troops from Glarondar engage the southern force and repel them. They then pass through the Tannath Gap, attack the Thayans at Emmech from the rear.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 147

events.text: Thay later invades Rashemen, entering from the east. While the Witches of Rashemen deal with flooding caused by Red Wizards of Thay, the Thayan forces cross the foothills of the High Country. They are repelled by angered elementals.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 147

events.text: Alasklerbanbastos, the Great Bone Wyrm, together with his chromatic dragon followers, seize control over parts of Chessenta: Mordulkin, Mount Thulbane, Thamor, Threskel, and the Watcher's Cape.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 147

events.text: Town of Priapurl becomes besieged by a one-orc army Slogg Ogrum who managed to to almost bring the town to its knees if not for the Mindulgulph Mercenary Company, who eventually slew the threat. The resons behind the orc's attack remained a mystery.

Currag Blackstone, son and heir to Angus Blackstone, dies in mysterious circumstances, apparently falling 40 feet (12.2 meters). His brother Gwyeth Blackstone is killed by the moorhound Warlock after Gwyeth tries to kill their other brother Hanrald Blackstone. Angus himself dies after having betrayed the throne to Talassans, killed by a spell cast by the Prophet of Talos that was intended for Deirdre Kendrick.

Grintharke, the balor ruler of Hellgate Keep, dies fighting seven Evereskan elves wielding the Shattering Swords of Coronal Ynloeth in his own gladiatorial arena. He manages to take down three of them with him, while the other four eventually die fighting the other demons in the keep, with at least one of them killing his vrock lieutenant. Many more demons would die that night through in-fighting, each wanting to assume control.
Pawldo of Lowhill, the halfling hero of the Moonshae Isles.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 29

events.text: Gotha the dracolich, servant of Talos, was defeated by Princess Alicia Kendrick of the Moonshae Isles.

Lliira, the Goddess of Joy, sends a prophet to every temple of Waukeen announcing that she will act as regent for Waukeen's portfolio, listen to prayers, and grant spells to the worshipers of Waukeen until the Merchant's Friend returns. Many of the Golden Lady's followers interpret this to mean their goddess is dead.
Talos, god of destruction, attempts to replace worship of the Earthmother of the Moonshae Isles with that of the Faerûnian pantheon.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 147

events.text: Malar sends the Elf Eater against the realm of Synnoria through the Fey-Alamtine portal, destroying the Llewyrr capital city of Chrysalis. It is eventually banished back to the Abyss.

Selûne guides a group of adventurers calling themselves the Seekers to discover her artifact, the Tear of Selûne, in Vaasa. Once they find it, she inexplicably withdraws her favor, and the members of the party are killed or captured by the Zhentarim.
cites: Player's Guide to the Forgotten Realms Campaign

events.text: After the Silver-Hafted Axe is retrieved by firbolgs from the dwarf settlement of Cambro, Dierdre Kendrick helps them free Grond Peaksmasher from his prison. Rather than helping Dierdre's master Talos, Grond joins with the Earthmother against him.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 29

events.text: Supporting their invasion of Rashemen, the Red Wizards of Thay melt glaciers in the Icerim Mountains. This leads to terrible flooding in Immilmar and Mulsantir, which the Witches handle.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 147

events.text: The Waterdhavians ships barred from Helmsport sail north, landing at Maztapan Island. From there, they found a colony called New Waterdeep near the Gulf of Kultaka. The Waterdhavian colonists negotiate and trade with the Kultakans, to the irritation of New Amn's Governor-General Cordell, as it limits New Amn's northern influence.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 147

events.text: Some of the Waterdhavian colonists from New Waterdeep continue north and build a second colony, Trythosford, at the mouth of a river on the mainland due west of Zilhatec Island.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 147

events.text: In Maztica, Tlincalli diviners create a gate and transport an expeditionary force of over a thousand of their people into the caves under Amn. The Tlincalli journey deeper into the Underdark and found the realm of Oaxapupta in the abandoned dwarf kingdom of Xothaerin.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 147

events.text: The Cult of the Dragon cell of Sembia successfully persuades a blue dragon from the Anauroch named Malygris to become a dracolich. Once the process is complete, Malygris then battles and kills the ruler of Anauroch's loose association of blue dragons, before taking his place.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 147

events.text: Waterdeep establishes limited trade with Maztica and Zakhara but, owing to the danger involved in the sea journeys, a lot of ships are lost. Twelve Waterdhavian ships arrive at Helmsport in Maztica, but the Lord-Governor of New Amn bars them access, owing to the council's restrictions on transoceanic trade. Several of the ships journey north and establish colonies. At the end of the year, eight of the ships return to Waterdeep, but three sink on the voyage. The remainder carry fresh trade for the Sword Coast North.
cites: City of Splendors (boxed set): Campaign Guide, с. 31
The Grand History of the Realms, с. 147

events.text: The mariliths Ssaarn, Mulvassyss, and Amassyra rise to power as the new rulers of Hellgate Keep, forming a triumvirate.
cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 147

cites: The Grand History of the Realms, с. 147

cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 29

Tristan himself is captured by a scrag king named Krell-Bane and taken to Kyrasti, the capital of the Coral Kingdom, where his left hand is cut off and delivered to his wife. Tristan is eventually rescued but divine magic fails to restore his missing hand.
cites: Dragon 362: Grand History of the Realms: The Moonshaes, с. 29
